entry.summary: St Helena: Australia isn't on the e-visa (visa-national) list, so you get a short-term entry permit at the border (up to 183 days). There is no visa on arrival for visa nationals. Ascension Island needs an e-visa for everyone, applied for at least 14 days ahead.
entry.next_check: Confirm with Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha's government.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: FCDO's laws and cultural differences section for Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha has no customs or etiquette guidance. A national etiquette page has not been searched for yet. Ask locally. St Helena Tourism says to greet people you pass and wave to drivers. Most shops close on Sundays. Bring GBP cash or arrange the Bank of St Helena Tourist Card, because there are no ATMs.
